Hi Elaine — great to hear and welcome.

Short answer: Redwood's standard policy is PO-required for one-time purchases and for invoice lines over $1,000, but we do have an exceptions workflow for recurring SaaS subscriptions under $5,000/year. Because your pilot is about $1,200/month (~$14.4k/year), this sits above the small-subscription auto-exception threshold.

Next steps I recommend:
- Please complete our vendor onboarding form (link below) and attach the W9 you sent.
- Monica in Procurement will review and route an exceptions request if appropriate.
- If we need a formal exception (given the annualized spend), Marcus (Finance) will confirm whether the exception can be approved at the procurement manager level or requires VP Finance sign-off.

I'll let Monica pick up with the exact paperwork and expected SLAs — Monica, can you confirm turnaround and who needs to sign off for a recurring spend in this band? Elaine, I'll also share our DocuSign MSA draft for redlines.

Hi all,

Thanks for the details, Elaine. Quick summary of Redwood's procurement policy and the exceptions path so expectations are clear:

Policy highlights:
- PO required for any single invoice > $1,000 by default.
- Recurring SaaS subscriptions under $5,000/year can be set up as "no-PO monthly invoicing" only when:
  * Contracted MSA is in place and countersigned,
  * Vendor has completed onboarding (company profile, W9, insurance if applicable), and
  * Vendor supports our automated invoice email parsing (or provides invoices with a consistent invoice number format).

Exceptions & approval matrix:
- Auto-approve exceptions up to $10,000 annual spend with Procurement Manager sign-off (me).
- $10,001 — $50,000 annual requires VP of Finance (Marcus Lin) approval.
- > $50,000 annual requires CFO/Finance Director approval and a formal risk review.

For AcmeAnalytics (~$14.4k/yr):
- This is above the procurement-manager auto-approve threshold and will need Marcus' approval.
- Timeline: once we receive the completed onboarding form + W9 + signed MSA draft, Procurement will create the exception request in our system (Jira SUP-2314) and route to Marcus. Typical SLAs: 3 business days for procurement review, 2–4 business days for finance approval barring questions.

Please attach the signed MSA if possible. If Marcus needs any additional finance documentation (POC of SaaS usage, cost-center approval), we'll request it in the ticket.

Elaine — feel free to upload the onboarding form and the draft MSA to the link Laura provided; I will kick off the exception request immediately once those are in.

Procurement checklist (what we need now):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (https://redwood.company/forms/vendor-onboarding)
- W9 (attached)
- Signed MSA (DocuSign link)
- Certificate of Insurance (if you handle sensitive customer data; not required for pilot)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: AcmeAnalytics_Onboarding_Form.pdf (please complete/upload)
